fields.Name: IT65 - AI Providers and Model Resolution
fields.Description: Domain 4 model-resolution seams, deterministic + LLM-free: AIP1 every Active LLM DriverClass ClassFactory-resolves against BaseLLM (environment-aware — loud skip when no provider packages are loaded, hard fail once any sibling resolves); AIP2 GetHighestPowerLLM returns the independently-computed max-PowerRank Active LLM and the vendor filter provably narrows; AIP3 DefaultAgentResolver precedence (explicit wins, bogus explicit falls through, chain always lands on an Active agent / Sage safety net). AI8/AI9 covered end-to-end by the live agent-loop bundle (AL6/AL7); AI14 belongs with ai-embeddings. 3 checks AIP1-AIP3.
